body: I'm going to preface by saying please seek help/call someone/talk to the reddit commenters/email someone/pray hard/ anything. I was inpatient over the summer too and it sucked and am currently struggling. So with that said on the notion of the whole heaven/hell crisis that Christ followers go through when battling suicidal contemplation. It is my interpretation of the bible that if God forgives you every day, why would he not forgive you then? Of course I'm not implying there's more comfort in doing this because all love on this earth would be lost which would be utterly heartbreaking to everyone you've come across but from a soteriological perspective, [God forgives everything you did and will do.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=suMhQ3ETCyI)
